summary: SMFG filed a Form 6-K announcing a share repurchase and cancellation program under Japanese Companies Act provisions. The board authorized repurchase of up to 40 million common shares (1% of outstanding) for up to JPY 180 billion (approx. $1.3B) via open-market purchases from May 14 to July 31, 2026. All repurchased shares will be cancelled on August 20, 2026, reducing outstanding shares and perking up EPS. No premium, tender, or advisor is involved; it is a direct buyback to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency. Watch for execution pace and any macro impact on JPY funding markets.
